name.full: Cowork Training Studio for Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork

description.short: Demo build: fictional training labs and demo packs. Not production ready.
description.full: Cowork Training Studio is a community demo build for Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork, not production ready. Choose a workshop blueprint and build story-driven LabSpec 2.1 labs, or build a DemoPackSpec 1.0 demo pack with checked Office inputs, prompts and a presenter guide. Both skills validate to zero errors and warnings, create files with Cowork's own tools, verify evidence and calculations, save exact rendered guides and offer a ZIP. Demo packs use fictional stand-in companies and people; public customer names are allowed only in audience/title/talk tracks and the filename prefix. Optional seeded items require confirmation and target only the presenter's own mailbox/calendar, never other people or Teams chats. Never include tenant data, real documents, personal information, credentials or secrets in a specification; lab specifications remain wholly fictional. The remote service is stateless and does not create files, mail or calendar items or call Microsoft Graph. This demo uses an anonymous Azure endpoint; availability and upload permissions depend on your environment.

agentConnectors.description: Demo tools for training formats, workshop blueprints, fictional LabSpec and DemoPackSpec validation, and offline HTML guides. Not production ready.
